Someone else might be wondering the same thing and might be too lazy to check the cardtext.

> Name: Anima Gathering
> Cardtype: Action
> Discipline: Auspex
> +1 stealth action.
> [aus] Put this card on this acting vampire and choose another minion you control. Burn this card if this minion untaps. During your untap phase, you may choose not to untap this minion as normal. The chosen minion gets +2 intercept.
> [AUS] As above, and the chosen minion also gets +1 bleed.
>
Yes, any untap (the normal untap during the untap phase, the infernal untap, the "I am Alexandra, I untap thee" untap, the Majesty untap, the "Force of Will + Freak Drive" untap (and go to torpor), and many others.

Off the top of my head, I can only think of two ways of getting an untapped vampire with Anima Gathering - that would require having him banished or contested, and then brought back / won. These two mechanisms bring vampires in play, untapped.
